name: blade_density
definition: m,Jx,Jy,Jz of all blades at fixed geometry
dependencies: density scale; centroid and geometry fixed; mass-linked inertias

name: tower_density
definition: m,Jx,Jy,Jz of tower and transition at fixed geometry
dependencies: density scale; centroid and geometry fixed; mass-linked inertias

name: nacelle_density
definition: nacelle mass and full centroidal inertia tensor
dependencies: density scale; centroid and geometry fixed; mass-linked inertias

name: hub_density
definition: hub mass and full centroidal inertia tensor
dependencies: mass-linked full tensor; gyro and rotational inertia updated

name: tower_stiffness
dependencies: proportional sectional stiffness scenario; geometry/mass fixed

name: blade_stiffness
dependencies: proportional sectional stiffness scenario; geometry/mass fixed

name: damping
definition: both existing Rayleigh target ratios at fixed target frequencies
dependencies: alpha and beta refitted from scaled targets; equilibrium unchanged by C

name: drivetrain_stiffness
definition: Factor de las seis rigideces del tren; 1e9 N/m y 1e10 N m/rad nominales
dependencies: Matriz relativa de conexión fija; todas las componentes escalan juntas

name: foundation_stiffness
definition: Factor de K del apoyo flexible heredado; valores por componente en nominal_foundation.csv
dependencies: K positiva y simétrica; M y C del apoyo fijas

name: foundation_damping
definition: Factor de C del apoyo flexible heredado
dependencies: C pasiva y simétrica; M y K del apoyo fijas

name: seismic_amplitude
definition: Factor del sismo sin(omega t)^3 multicomponente; magnitudes originales en m, m/s y m/s²
dependencies: ag/vg/ug se escalan por el mismo factor; frecuencias y ventana fijas
